rule: closed blocks whose signals reach M7+ (break even the old <= M6 tile rule, collide with parent straps and the die's M7); re-route OPPORTUNISTICALLY through tools/ref_tile at the M5 cap, top rank first -- no mass re-route. Tier 1 = under a congested die region (Qwen ROM M6/M8 rows; HBM hub / slice faces), 2 = other die-placed, 3 = die unknown / not die-placed. Within a tier: most M7-M9 signal wire first.
